title: Christmas Side Special!
subtitle: Fancy Potato Salad with Avocado and Corn
description: Whether you're vegan, vegetarian, flexitarian or simply searching for deliciousness, this hearty potato salad fits the bill. Loaded with sweet corn, creamy avocado, zingy pickled onion and roasted hazelnuts, it's the ideal addition to a summer celebration.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen hack). Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Quarter the unpeeled potatoes. Thinly slice the onion. Reserve a few fronds, then coarsely chop the dill, discarding the stems. Discard the husks and silks from the corn.

Bake veggies: Put the potato and corn on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tbs olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake for 10 mins, then add the hazelnuts to the side of the tray and bake for a further 10 mins or until the potato is golden and tender. Allow to cool slightly.
Pickle onion: Meanwhile, combine 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 2 tsp sugar in a bowl. Add the onion and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.
Make dressing: Put the mayonnaise, chopped dill, 1 tsp dijon mustard and 1 tsp pickling liquid in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Serve up: Slice the corn kernels from the cobs. Cut the avocado into 1cm-thick wedges. Drain the onion, discarding the pickling liquid. Arrange the potato, avocado, corn and pickled onion on a large serving platter. Scatter over the hazelnuts, drizzle with the dressing and top with the reserved dill fronds. Enjoy! Serves 3-4.

Kitchen hack: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag and close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. Add a banana to the bag to make the avocado ripen faster.
